description: This file implements the NativeJSPlugin class for the WPEFramework plugin, including initialization, deinitialization, and information reporting functionalities.

classes.name: NativeJS
classes.description: A plugin class for managing NativeJS interactions within the WPEFramework, including lifecycle management and service registration.

methods.name: NativeJS
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the singleton instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the NativeJS plugin with the provided service, setting up the native JavaScript interface and environment.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters the plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with the service name.
